commits_data.title: radius: Update more dictionaries from FreeRADIUS 3.2.4
commits_data.message:
radius: Update more dictionaries from FreeRADIUS 3.2.4

Unwind TLVs from the ruckus dictionary so that the Wireshark parser
can handle it.

Update dictionary.3gpp and merge changes with FreeRADIUS 3.2.4

Update dictionary.3gpp2 to format closer to the FreeRADIUS version. Wireshark
has a lot of updated attributes and values not in FreeRADIUS.

For dictionary.ericsson.ab, use the recent FreeRADIUS release.
We don't need the version with alternate attributes with underscores
that Redback used at one point. (We only can have one display value
for each attribute anyway.)

Update dictionary.extreme to bring the formatting close to FreeRADIUS.
We have some additional attributes from vendor provided files.

Ping #15458
